title: Put a value and a manager on a job

steps.caption: The pipeline board
steps.narration: Put a contract value and a manager on a job, right from the pipeline board.

steps.caption: The job's card
steps.narration: Find the job's card. This one is a tile backsplash in Estimating, with no value yet.

steps.caption: The pencil
steps.narration: Click the pencil on the card.

steps.caption: Name
steps.narration: Edit project opens. You can rename the job here.

steps.caption: Stage
steps.narration: If the job has moved on, change its stage. This one goes to Proposal Sent.

steps.caption: Owner
steps.narration: Under Owner, choose the person on your team who manages this job.

steps.caption: The card, updated
steps.narration: The card has moved to Proposal Sent, and it now shows the value.

steps.caption: Open it again
steps.narration: Open the pencil again any time.

steps.caption: The owner is saved
steps.narration: The owner you chose is saved with the job.

steps.caption: Pipeline value
steps.narration: Pipeline value adds up your open jobs, so the new value is counted here too.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: You will find the board under Pipeline, in the left menu.

youtube.title: How to set a job's contract value and manager | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Use the pencil on a pipeline card in ConstructHUB CRM to set a job's contract value, change its stage and choose the team member who owns it. The pipeline value on Home counts the new number. Recorded in a demo workspace.
